## Scraping the FSB academic departments
```{r}
dept_url = "https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/Accountancy/all"

page = rvest::read_html(dept_url)
```

```{r}
# get all the table rows
rows = rvest::html_elements(page, "tr")

# create empty lists
department = c()
name = c()
position = c()
website = c()

# extract the 4 pieces from every row
for (row in rows[2:length(rows)]) {
  
  department = c(department,
                 rvest::html_element(row, "td:nth-child(1)") |>
                   rvest::html_text2())
  
  name = c(name,
           rvest::html_element(row, "td:nth-child(3) strong a") |>
             rvest::html_text2())
  
  position = c(position,
               rvest::html_element(row, "td:nth-child(3) i") |>
                 rvest::html_text2())
  
  website = c(website,
              rvest::html_element(row, "td:nth-child(3) a") |>
                rvest::html_attr("href"))
}

# put those lists into a dataframe
accountancy_df = data.frame(
  department,
  name,
  position,
  website
)

head(accountancy_df)
```
